description.narrative:
Outcome 1: Women are more engaged and demanding towards equal representation of women in decision making positions, specifically in the politics.
Output 1.1: Women (who attended political schools and engaged with KA-DER in various contexts) are empowered and improved their capacities concerning equal representation of women in decision making, specifically in politics.
Output 1.2: Enhanced institutional capacity of KA.DER by strengthening its competencies in various fields.
Outcome 2: Stakeholders (engaged with KADERs work) are adopting a supporting approach towards engagement & participation of women as candidates/key roles regarding central elections in 2023.
Output 2.1: Information on the state of women's participation and equal representation in Turkey became available via monitoring.
Output 2.2: Increased awareness of stakeholders (political parties, media etc.) potential voters regarding the political participation and representation of women.

Projektets syfte är att skapa en positiv påverkan på starkare krav på jämlikt deltagande i alla beslutsfattande mekanismer med en jämlik representation av kvinnor inom alla områden i det sociala livet.
The project aims to create a positive impact towards stronger demand about equal participation in all decision-making mechanisms with the equal representation of women in all areas of social life.

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative: Despite significant challenges in terms of internal capacity, KA.DER achieved some positive results in areas such as election awareness and training local women politicians, contributing to women's political empowerment.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
